title: fix(metadata-protocol,app-shell): serve a pair's mapping override, let a pair remove any override it holds, name a working remedy for an excluded type (#30062)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg9beNpM7b18QnbuwqgHvEwS)_

domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 客户在定制包（`BASE.custom`）里声明覆盖的 mapping 现在真的生效（导入用的是改过的映射）；定制包里任何可覆盖类型的覆盖都能删掉，删掉后基包原件回来（doc、mapping 以前报 403）；给不可覆盖类型加 `overrides` 时，拒绝信息引用该类型自己的依据并给出一条走得通的出路；「全部元数据」里的类型瓷砖在只读包上显示「可定制」当且仅当 Studio 真的给了「定制」入口（flow、app 以前误显示「只读」）。
- **为什么改：** ADR-0146 D2 原文：定制包里的项替换基包的项，删掉它就回到基包的项；ADR-0146 的 revert（「恢复包原件」）就是删掉 `.custom` 里的覆盖项。旧行为对 doc/mapping 拒绝了这条路，mapping 覆盖保存发布后不起作用，拒绝文案一律叫人「新建同类」而有些类型根本不能新建。
- **风险与回滚：** 删除只对定制包自己的行放宽（点名 `?package=BASE.custom`）；点名基包的删除仍是原答案，覆盖照旧生效（消融 A3 为证）。错误码与状态不变，无 spec 改动。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`（`isPairRowRemoval` 的放宽与 `excludedTypeRemedy`），`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.ts`（`SEALED_ROW_SERVED_OVERRIDE_TYPES` 加 `mapping`），`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PageShell.tsx`（`studioOffersCustomize`）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts -t 30062`：每个可覆盖类型在两种内核上，删除定制包的覆盖后所有读都回到基包原件；点名基包的删除不动任何东西。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。第 3 项（翻译与覆盖自身 label 的优先级）不在本 PR，见 Acceptance notes。

Refs #30062 (items 1, 2, 4, 5)

Clause-②: no — ADR-0146 D2 ("an item in the customization package replaces the base's item, and removing it brings the base's back") and ADR-0146's revert ("Restore package original" = delete the overriding item from `.custom`, so the base's document is served again) already admit both the served mapping override and the pair's removal of its own doc or mapping override; the 403 and the unserved row refused that text. A removal naming the base keeps today's answer, and no accepted write is refused that was accepted before.
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #30229 — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`'s ADR-0146 paragraph says the read honours a pair's declared override "today only for a view, dashboard, report, email_template, translation or flow"; that list predates page, app, dataset, doc and book, and now mapping, and it says nothing of the removal. `skills/**` is outside this card's order, so the seat carries the edit.

## What changes

**Item 1 — a mapping override is served.** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.ts`: `mapping` joins `SEALED_ROW_SERVED_OVERRIDE_TYPES` (page, app, dataset, doc, book) and `BORROWED_ENVELOPE_DECLINED_TYPES`. A mapping is sealed (`allowEnvironmentOverlay: false`) and open for override (ADR-0146 D2, no D9 condition), and its pair row was declined with every other stored row of a name a managed package ships, so a saved and published mapping override answered the base's body on every read. Now the by-name read (no `?package` and `?package=BASE`), both lists, the layered read and the pair's per-package layer serve it. The import door (`@objectstack/rest` `import-mapping.ts:63`) and the connector pull (`service-automation` `connector-pull.ts:244`) resolve a named mapping through that package-less `getMetaItem`, so they get the pair's mapping. The served arm was chosen, not "the save refuses loudly", so `Clause-②: no` does not narrow. Comment-only updates in `protocol-lock-state.ts`, `protocol-registry-hydration.ts` and `protocol.ts` name the sixth type.

**Item 2 — the pair's removal of its own override works for every overridable type.** Measured: the doc and mapping 403 came from `refusePackagedBaseRemoval` (`protocol-write-gates.ts`: a sealed managed item on a kernel that does not merge the overlay at read), which `deleteMetaItemUnaudited` skips only when `isPairRowRemoval` admits the row, and `isPairRowRemoval` admitted only `CONDITIONS_DELIVERED = {flow}`. `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`: `isPairRowRemoval` now admits the pair's row for every type `isOverridableMetadataType` opens (`isOpenOverrideType`, so `action` still waits for D9); the pair check is unchanged (the package the removal names must be the base's customization package). The repository's delete gate then takes the `runtime-only` intent the declared save wrote, which every overridable type's `allowRuntimeCreate` admits. No spec flag moved. A removal naming the base (`?package=BASE`) is untouched: on the host-config kernel it answers `{ success: true, reset: false }` with "No row … remains" and removes nothing; on the environment kernel a doc or mapping still answers `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`.

**Item 4 — the All metadata tile agrees with the Customize door.** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PageShell.tsx`: new `studioOffersCustomize(type)` = overridable and offered by a Studio door (`isStudioCustomizeType`: view, dashboard, report, app; `AREA_FORM_EDITOR_TYPES`: email_template, translation; and the flow header). On a read-only package `typeStateWord` reads it instead of `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, so flow and app read 可定制, and doc, mapping, page, dataset and book read 只读 until a door exists. `StudioCustomizeControls.tsx` is not touched (seat ruling): a door added to its list moves the tile with it.

**Item 5 — an excluded type's refusal names a remedy that works for it.** `judgeOverrideWrite`'s `declared_type_not_overridable` sentence cited ADR-0146 D6 and told every type to "create your own TYPE under a new name". It now cites the type's own basis from `OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION` (`EXCLUSION_BASIS_CITATION`: D6 for the security catalog and code-only types, D1 for a datasource, D9 for a behavioural switch, D10 for a field, ADR-0126 §3 for one-shot types, D2 otherwise) and `excludedTypeRemedy` prescribes, in order: Setup › Datasources for a datasource; the object extension for a field (`OBJECT_EXTENSION_ITEM_DOOR`); "create your own TYPE under a new name" only where the registry admits a runtime create; the type's ADR-0126 Regime C prescription where it has a row (`packagedBaseRegimePrescription`: a sharing rule names `POST /api/v1/sharing/rules` and its switch); Setup › Queues for a queue; otherwise "an X is defined only in package source, so it changes only with a new version of 'BASE'". `articleFor` fixes "a api". Code (`NOT_OVERRIDABLE`), status (403) and rule are unchanged, and the permission sentence is byte-identical (pinned by `runtime` `meta-object-extension-item-door-fit.test.ts:161`).

**Docs (head `5663983b`, added by the card thread after the CI Docs Drift Check, comment 6648033732).** `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`: a declared override is served for every type of `OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` but `action` (which waits for ADR-0146 D9's conditions); the import door and the connector pull run the pair's mapping; a new bullet, removing the override (`DELETE …?package=hotcrm.custom`, "Restore package original") brings the base's back. `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`: a capability is not copied under a new name (its registry entry has `allowRuntimeCreate: false`); it changes only with a new version of the package that declares it, and an `overrides` on a type that takes none is refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` with that type's own route. This PR made the old sentences false, so they are fixed here.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts`: `mapping` joins the sealed served types (by-name, lists, layered, per-package, after a restart, with and without a metadata service). New describe `[#30062] a pair's removal of its own override brings the base's item back`, over view, dashboard, report, email_template, page, app, dataset, doc, book, mapping, flow and translation, on both kernels: (1) the removal naming the pair succeeds, the pair row is gone, and every read serves the base's item again; (2) a removal naming the base keeps main's exact answer per kernel and type, removes nothing, and the override stays served.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-flow-custom-override.test.ts`: the old flow-only admission pins (a mapping pair-row delete 403, a view delete `override-artifact`) are rewritten to the new behaviour (removed; `runtime-only`). They pinned the #28412 flow-only scope (contract review 6559358939), which item 2 supersedes.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.packaged-base-refusal.test.ts`: each of the 17 excluded non-D10 types cites its own basis, never reads "a" before a vowel, names a create only where the registry admits one, and the named remedies (sharing rule route and switch, Setup › Queues, Setup › Datasources, object extension, new version of the base) appear where they belong.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.sealed-override.test.ts`: the served set includes `mapping`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.stateVocabulary-29705.test.tsx`: for every overridable type plus permission, object and api, under both overlay flags, the tile reads 可定制 exactly when a door offers Customize; flow and app read 可定制, doc and mapping 只读, a writable flow 可新增; the flow list header renders 可定制.

### Ablations

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode); for objectql legs the mutated `metadata-protocol` was rebuilt and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` proved the marker in `dist/` before the run, then absent after restore. Each leg restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

| # | Mutation | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `isPairRowRemoval` back to flow-only | 7 / 78 red: doc and mapping pair removals on both kernels, the mapping pair-row delete, the view intent |
| A2 | `mapping` out of `SEALED_ROW_SERVED_OVERRIDE_TYPES` | 6 / 71 red: mapping served with and without a metadata service, mapping removal and base-named control on both kernels |
| A3 | the pair check widened to admit a base-named removal | 2 / 71 red: doc and mapping, environment kernel, base-named removal |
| A4 | `typeStateWord` back to reading `allowEnvironmentOverlay` | 15 / 114 red: every per-type agreement row, flow/app, the flow header |
| A5 | the refusal back to the old "a TYPE … (ADR-0146 D6) … create your own" sentence | 16 / 87 red: 14 per-type citation rows, the named-remedy row, the code-only row |

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 3 (label precedence) is not here.** Ruled (6631250894): a translation in the pair, then the override's own label, then the base's translation. Measured on `origin/main` `b7075d99`: the rule that keeps an override's own label over the base's translation exists only in `translateView`, `translateDashboard`, `translateReport` and `translateObject` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, the `packagedBase` option), and `@objectstack/rest` wires `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` (`meta-item-read-gate.ts:2954`) for object, dashboard, view and report only. `translatePage` (`:3393`), `translateDataset` (`:2270`), `translateApp` (`:1756`) and `translateBook` (`:2441`) take only `ResolveOptions` and apply the catalog translation unconditionally, which is the card's page/dataset defect. The ruling's first rank is unmet for every type: where the value differs from the base's, the resolver keeps the authored value, so a translation in the pair never gets in. Both halves change `packages/spec/src/**`, so the seat splits the spec half to the spec lane; the server half (`getPackaged*Base` accessors and REST table rows) stays on #30062.
- **Interaction with #30063 and #30064 (in-flight `domain:ui` cards).** Both add a door to `STUDIO_CUSTOMIZE_TYPES` (page and dataset). The new agreement rows derive from that list, so they follow on their own. The older #29705 pins in the same test file hard-code `page` 只读 (the tile at `:129`, the list header at `:178`–`:186`); whichever of this PR and #30063 lands second flips those to 可定制. #30064's claim names "All metadata tile for datasets": after this PR the tile follows the door with no extra change.
- **The flow-only removal scope of #28412 is superseded** for the pair's own row only; a base-named removal is unchanged on both kernels and pinned per type.
- **Translation** in the removal pins: the manifest door the harness boots through registers no translation artifact (a code package's translation file does, through the metadata plugin), so the base's bundle is registered with `engine.registry.registerItem('translation', …, BASE)`, and the removal pin reads the base's bundle back from there.
- Serial constraint: #30106 (`protocol-served-overrides.ts`, read path) landed as PR #30207 (02:52Z) and is in `origin/main` `bb86ff96c`, merged at head `c5033471`.
- **Merge-queue round (head `c5033471`).** Merged `origin/main` `bb86ff96c` after #30063 (page door, `797f9257c`) and #30064 (dataset door, `AREA_CUSTOMIZE_EDITOR_TYPES`, `6f095b9c1`) landed: `studioOffersCustomize` also reads `AREA_CUSTOMIZE_EDITOR_TYPES`, and `DirectoryPage.stateVocabulary-29705.test.tsx`'s 'a read-only package: overlay types can be customized…', 'the view list header reads 可定制, the page list header 只读' and 'typeStateWord: the mapping in every context' now expect page 可定制 (filter count 隐藏只读 (4); the read-only control row is `api`), per #30062 item 4 and ADR-0146 D2. This is the "whichever lands second flips those" case noted above. Local: that file 114/114, the 6 files that read PageShell/DirectoryPage 150/150, app-shell type-check 0.
